scope.provenance_policy: Repositories remain independent provenance units. Relations are typed handoffs or adapters, never implied code or evidence ownership.
scope.graph_policy: Graphify structure is routing evidence. Scientific claims are admitted only from repository-owned primary documents or frozen artifacts.

workspace_extensions.claim_ceiling: Exact two-world local quotient and coarse-summary counterexample only; the full simulator or warning-domain quotient remains open.
workspace_extensions.provenance_boundary: The adapter consumes opaque source records and does not import the simulator or alter warning calibration, endpoints, seeds, or evidence ledgers.

classification_vocabulary.definable: An object or predicate has an exact mathematical, computational, or operational definition in the current program.
classification_vocabulary.conditionally_definable: The definition is exact only after a carrier, grammar, mechanism family, history relation, observation contract, scale, target, or simulator closure is declared.
classification_vocabulary.empirically_identifiable: The available evidence resolves the declared object or target under an explicit observation and reliability contract.
classification_vocabulary.reportable: A deterministic, typed, set-valued, bounded, or target-only statement is licensed even if the full state or mechanism remains unresolved.
classification_vocabulary.fundamentally_undefinable: The requested object cannot be uniquely recovered from the stated information class; an impossibility or non-identifiability result applies.
classification_vocabulary.currently_undefinable: The program lacks a required theorem, bridge, calibration, independent validation, or measurement, without claiming principled impossibility.

ontology.label: Temporally extended ecological world
ontology.definition: A possible world containing relevant history, present configuration, latent response structure, and declared counterfactual future responses.
ontology.condition: The scientifically relevant coordinates and contemplated interventions must be declared.

ontology.label: Scientific contract
ontology.definition: C=(Gamma,H,Theta,D;T): future responsibilities, inherited meanings/history, retained mechanisms, evidence architecture, and report or decision target.

ontology.label: Least-information adequate state
ontology.definition: The unique coarsest finite partition preserving every distinction required by a declared scientific contract on an admissible common carrier.
ontology.condition: Currently proved for declared finite exact carriers and refinement closures; no general continuous or stochastic trajectory theorem is claimed.

ontology.label: Bounded eco-genetic CREST quotient
ontology.definition: A CREST-side adapter computes the coarsest adequate partition of an explicitly declared finite eco-genetic witness carrier while keeping source simulation and warning ledgers external.
ontology.condition: The aligned/anti-aligned carrier yields an exact two-block local quotient; full-domain minimality requires independently established carrier coverage.

ontology.label: Provenance-preserving research-universe registry
ontology.definition: A machine-readable index of repository-owned ontology objects, contracts, claims, evidence types, non-claims, definability classes, and typed cross-repository bridges.
ontology.condition: The registry preserves source repository and snapshot boundaries and does not become the scientific evidence owner.

ontology.label: Snapshot sufficiency
ontology.definition: A present snapshot is sufficient exactly when equality of snapshots implies equality of the contract-relative adequate states.
ontology.condition: Empirical identification requires a defensible map from observations to the world distinctions required by the contract.

ontology.label: Future/composition obstruction
ontology.definition: A distinction compressed under a closed future grammar becomes necessary when the legal grammar is opened; exact interface memory can grow by m bits in the declared family.
ontology.condition: The small exact open interface requested may not exist; the lower bound is finite-model and grammar-relative.

ontology.label: Historical/semantic obstruction
ontology.definition: A source macro-law may fail after non-nested replacement; coarsest exact repair, transport defect, route coherence, and minimum history augmentation quantify the repair.
ontology.condition: The replacement relation, histories, action grammar, and finite systems are declared rather than inferred from field data.

ontology.label: Mechanism-robust state and law
ontology.definition: The coarsest observation-preserving quotient retaining only response-type distinctions that can alter declared future behavior; reports may be deterministic, typed, or set-valued.
ontology.condition: A candidate-independent deterministic law is impossible when retained response types disagree on the required transition maps.

ontology.label: Evidence licensing
ontology.definition: An experiment induces compatible latent-world classes. A deterministic target is licensed exactly when it is constant on each compatible class; otherwise ambiguity must be retained.
ontology.condition: Reliability, failure architecture, calibration, target, risk, and cost must be declared.

ontology.label: Reportable target
ontology.definition: A target can be deterministically reportable even when the complete adequate state is unresolved; the sharp state report can remain set-valued.

ontology.label: Monitoring-resolution debt
ontology.definition: The additional finite partition resolution required for fixed evidence to identify a strengthened adequate state.

ontology.label: Restricted admissible causal hypotheses
ontology.definition: The set of causal programs and parameters compatible with a declared model family, constraints, observation map, discrepancy, and tolerance.

ontology.label: Channel identifiability
ontology.definition: Under positive W(z)=F(z)E(z), W-only observations cannot distinguish which factor changed; W plus one exact channel, or a stably calibrated proxy, identifies relative changes.
ontology.condition: Empirical identification requires a valid W/F/E mapping and direct or calibrated channel data.

ontology.label: Next-observation value and RACH-SEQ
ontology.definition: Observation ranking that reduces the declared unresolved causal-equivalence structure without selecting a best model by fiat.
ontology.condition: Validated on controlled synthetic systems; ecological benefit requires a source-specific observation adapter and evidence contract.

ontology.label: Complete eco-genetic simulator state
ontology.definition: The explicit current simulator state plus future forcing and stochastic law, which is Markov/future-sufficient under the declared closure.
ontology.condition: This is a theorem about the declared simulator representation, not natural ecological sufficiency or minimality.

ontology.label: Loss-generating eco-genetic state
ontology.definition: A warning-blindly calibrated state/closure that generates the downstream functional-loss process and fixes feasibility, incidence, heterogeneity, and trajectory identity before warning inspection.

ontology.label: Conditional genetic warning
ontology.definition: Baseline-relative H_alpha/H_gamma erosion preceding realized functional loss within one frozen loss-generating state.
ontology.condition: Strictly reproduced within the frozen simulator state; universal thresholds, direction-only causation, and cross-state portability remain undefined.

ontology.label: Endpoint-relevant empirical partial state
ontology.definition: A synchronized measured candidate state that earns state status by held-out endpoint prediction before origin or history is tested for residual information.
ontology.condition: The proposed search basis is not assumed sufficient; natural full-state sufficiency remains open.

ontology.label: Finite world-set forecast state
ontology.definition: The surviving set of declared transition worlds, their per-world support, and union/intersection projections into possible, robust, unresolved, and robustly unreachable states.
ontology.condition: Labels are conditional on the declared finite world universe and positive evidence.

ontology.label: Label-invariant world-set prediction summary
ontology.definition: A symmetric compression of the surviving EOG support set used as the default predictive interface while exact world identity remains an auditable latent update state.
ontology.condition: The revised two-layer prediction head requires a fresh independent validation.

ontology.label: Observability and sensing-error state
ontology.definition: A record of noise source, confidence, false-event risk, missed-event risk, attribution risk, audit priority, and whether the interval is clean, confounded, high-risk, unobservable, or unknown.
ontology.condition: Field ecological use awaits hardware-in-the-loop NoiseBench calibration.

definability_ledger.question: Does one context-free intrinsic ecological state exist?
definability_ledger.reason: CREST defines state relative to a declared scientific contract; no contract-independent partition is claimed.

definability_ledger.question: Can a least-information adequate state be computed on a declared finite carrier?
definability_ledger.reason: CREST J1 supplies the unique coarsest partition under declared closures.

definability_ledger.question: Is the present snapshot sufficient?
definability_ledger.reason: It is a factorization predicate relative to the contract; empirical use requires a valid observation-to-world map.

definability_ledger.question: Can one comparably small interface survive arbitrary future-grammar opening?
definability_ledger.reason: CCOC supplies families with unbounded exact memory inflation.

definability_ledger.question: Can an inherited macro-law always survive non-nested replacement unchanged?
definability_ledger.reason: MLTR fiber-split obstructions can refute the carried merge; coarsest repair is the honest replacement.

definability_ledger.question: Can one deterministic law ignore retained mechanisms that disagree on required responses?
definability_ledger.reason: MRM permits deterministic candidate-independent reporting exactly under response-type agreement; otherwise typed or set-valued reports are required.

definability_ledger.question: Can a deterministic target be reported when it varies inside an evidence-compatible class?
definability_ledger.reason: CED requires ambiguity retention; no observation policy can retroactively license an unresolved deterministic value.

definability_ledger.question: Can a coarse target be reported while the full state is unresolved?
definability_ledger.reason: CED/CREST target constancy can license decision-safe ignorance.

definability_ledger.question: Can F versus E channel change be identified from W-only observations?
definability_ledger.reason: RACH N1 proves structural non-identifiability under positive W=FE.

definability_ledger.question: Can RACH identify channels with W and one exact or stably calibrated channel?
definability_ledger.reason: N2-N4 provide the identification condition; the current Campanula record does not satisfy it.

definability_ledger.question: Is the complete eco-genetic simulator state future-sufficient?
definability_ledger.reason: Yes for the declared Markov closure plus future forcing/stochastic law; minimality and natural sufficiency are not established.

definability_ledger.question: Can the aligned/anti-aligned eco-genetic witness share one coarse-summary state for the exact next-interaction target?
definability_ledger.reason: No. The implemented CREST adapter returns two required blocks on the declared two-world carrier because the exact next interaction fields differ.

definability_ledger.question: Is the least adequate quotient of the full frozen eco-genetic warning or management domain now defined?
definability_ledger.reason: The bounded witness refutes one coarse merge, but full carrier coverage and response signatures for a declared warning or management target have not been established.

definability_ledger.question: Is baseline-relative genetic erosion a reproducible warning?
definability_ledger.reason: Strictly replicated within one frozen loss-generating simulator state only.

definability_ledger.question: Is there a universal genetic warning threshold or portable warning across eco-genetic states?
definability_ledger.reason: Absolute thresholds failed and cross-state portability is bounded rather than established.

definability_ledger.question: Is S_emp a sufficient natural ecological state?
definability_ledger.reason: It is a search basis; candidate coordinates must first demonstrate held-out endpoint information.

definability_ledger.question: Can positive occurrence data identify the true historical route?
definability_ledger.reason: EOG constrains a compatible world set but does not identify historical truth.

definability_ledger.question: Is EOG exact world identity the correct predictive representation?
definability_ledger.reason: The frozen Glanville test found it adverse; exact identity remains useful for audit/update, not direct prediction.

definability_ledger.question: Is the revised EOG two-layer predictive head externally valid?
definability_ledger.reason: A fresh independent test is required.

definability_ledger.question: Do SDMR Product-A/B biological claims hold on real plants?
definability_ledger.reason: The architecture is execution-ready, but the real bulk-data empirical sequence has not established them.

definability_ledger.question: Does an ACSP patch give occupancy probability or an exact site?
definability_ledger.reason: The validated object is an enriched candidate patch under the frozen support contract, not calibrated occupancy.

definability_ledger.question: Is a PolliPi mesh decision a confirmed visitor event?
definability_ledger.reason: The decision is observation metadata and requires human/calibrated confirmation.

definability_ledger.question: Are InsePi observability risks field calibrated?
definability_ledger.reason: Hardware-in-the-loop NoiseBench data are still required.

definability_ledger.question: Does Azami spatial association identify adaptation or pollinator mechanism?
definability_ledger.reason: The current image-observational evidence does not contain the required causal or evolutionary information.

definability_ledger.question: Did a modular selection mosaic cause EAzami functional radiation?
definability_ledger.reason: It is a competing hypothesis awaiting time-resolved analyses, model discrimination, and trait-specific fitness evidence.

definability_ledger.question: Does visible color establish pigment reactivation in chun?
definability_ledger.reason: Reactivation requires both a phylogenetic active-suppressed-active history and molecular pathway retention.

definability_ledger.question: Does shimahotarubukuro Pst establish selection?
definability_ledger.reason: Pst is a phenotypic divergence surrogate and is not Qst or selection evidence.

definability_ledger.question: Is BITA joint-cost curvature zero because no strict study measured it?
definability_ledger.reason: Absence of measurement makes kappa unidentified, not zero.

definability_ledger.question: Can island environmental compatibility be called visitation, service, or historical pollinator loss?
definability_ledger.reason: The estimator represents climatic-environmental compatibility only.

definability_ledger.question: Does FCP identify a unique moisture mechanism?
definability_ledger.reason: Directional point estimates are reportable, but adjusted/phylogenetic intervals and the observational design do not identify that mechanism.

definability_ledger.question: Does ODSP retain an independent active method?
definability_ledger.reason: No. Its only current object is the supersession/migration record to EOG.

definability_ledger.question: Does theouni become the owner of the scientific claims and evidence it indexes?
definability_ledger.reason: No. Its declared contract is meta-registry and navigation; scientific ownership remains with the source repository and pinned artifact.

architecture_diagnostics.exact_cross_repository_blob_duplication: No substantive scientific code/data duplicate was found across the 23 audited scientific repositories. theouni intentionally republishes registry and generated visualization snapshots as a meta-index, without acquiring scientific ownership.
duplicate_concept_substrates: Partition/refinement substrate appears in CREST, CCOC, MLTR, MRM, and CED but has distinct typed ownership.
Observation selection appears in MRM, CED, and microdonta/RACH with different inputs, targets, and reliability guarantees.

State appears as contract-relative quotient, complete simulator state, candidate empirical partial state, EOG latent world state, and sensor observability state; these must not be treated as one untyped object.

graphify.use_ceiling: Navigation and adapter discovery only; not scientific proof.
